purpose: Fill Fremennik regional skilling gaps missing from progression-enrichment-regional-skilling-2026-07-25 and gaps-2026-07-26: Lunar spellbook skilling utility (Bake Pie, Telekinetic Grind, NPC Contact, Plank Make and related), Managing Miscellania supply backbone, Neitiznot yak/Crafting loop, Keldagrim infrastructure, Waterbirth/Rellekka hubs, sparkling wisps, and diary boots. Does not re-row fremennik:lava-flow-mine or fremennik:imcando-pickaxe except as cross-links.

policy.region_rule: region_hint marks where the unlock or activity lives in the current planner taxonomy. region_hints marks a cross-region chain. required_regions is only used when both regions are needed for a full stack, not for dual dig-site claims. Quest auto-completion and League-specific overrides must be applied separately.
policy.no_trade_rule: Prioritise unlocks that materially change self-sufficient progression, training throughput, supply access, or tool progression. Do not mirror every shop item.
policy.rate_rule: Do not promote stale XP/hour figures. Training rates belong in training datasets; this file records unlock state and effects.
policy.dupe_rule: Skip exact re-rows of fremennik:lava-flow-mine and fremennik:imcando-pickaxe from 2026-07-25. Expand only missing infrastructure (Birthright geyser path, Keldagrim hub, Miscellania, Lunar utility).

activity_additions.name: Lunar spellbook unlock
requirements: Lunar Diplomacy completed (Fremennik Trials plus Lost City chain in the normal game)
Astral altar on Lunar Isle to switch to the Lunar spellbook
Astral runes for nearly all Lunar casts (Baba Yaga shop / astral altar craft after Lunar Diplomacy)
unlocks: Lunar spellbook (non-combat / skilling-heavy utility book)
Base skilling spells including Bake Pie, NPC Contact, Cure Plant, String Jewellery, Magic Imbue, Fertile Soil, Make Leather, and later Telekinetic Grind
Lunar Isle lodestone and Moonclan teleport network once unlocked
Access path into Livid Farm produce-point spell unlocks on Lunar Isle
activity_additions.notes: Fremennik owns the normal-game Lunar unlock geography (Lunar Isle / Fremennik Trials line). Dream Mentor and Livid Farm layer additional spells on top of the base book. Do not invent League auto-quest behaviour; resolve via Equilibrium quest overlay. Elven grimoire spellbook swap is a Tirannwn cross-pressure after hard Fremennik achievements, not a substitute for unlocking Lunar itself.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Fremennik dependency for the normal Lunar unlock path. Lost City is a pre-quest outside Fremennik; treat as quest-chain pressure, not a second region claim for the spellbook itself.

activity_additions.name: Bake Pie (Lunar)
requirements: Lunar Diplomacy and Lunar spellbook active
65 Magic
1 astral, 5 fire, 4 water runes per inventory bake cycle
unlocks: Bake Pie spell: cooks all uncooked pies in the backpack without a range or fire
100% success cook path for pies (no burn risk from the spell path)
Bankstanding Cooking processing for high-value pie ladder once ingredients are stocked
activity_additions.notes: Ironman food and Cooking progression pressure is often Fremennik-skewed because Bake Pie is the clean pie-cook tool. Ingredient supply remains multi-region; the spell unlock is Fremennik. Pair with Neitiznot yak meat / Miscellania fish when valuing self-sufficient food, not as a substitute for Menaphos or other food trains.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Fremennik Lunar dependency. Do not invent pie XP/hour; surface unlock state only.

activity_additions.name: Telekinetic Grind (Lunar)
requirements: Lunar Diplomacy and Lunar spellbook active
85 Magic
1 law and 2 astral runes per cast
unlocks: Telekinetic Grind: pestle-and-mortar grind up to 60 stackable targeted items (or a backpack set of non-stackables) in one action
High-throughput Herblore herb-tar processing when swamp tar and clean herbs are stocked
High-throughput Crafting extra-fine sand processing from sandstone
Bulk secondary prep (chocolate dust, dragon scale dust, goat horn dust, crushed nests, Armadyl dust, and other pestle products)
activity_additions.notes: Spell unlock is Fremennik. Resource regions are separate pressure: swamp tar often Misthalin, red sandstone Desert, crystal sandstone Tirannwn, desert goat horns Desert. App training rows already flag multi_region_dependency for tar and sandstone; this row is the Fremennik unlock gate those methods share. Does not grind noted items, Beast of Burden inventories, or dragonstones.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Always pair the spell region (Fremennik) with the resource region of the method being planned. Never score Telekinetic Grind methods as Fremennik-only XP.

activity_additions.name: NPC Contact (Lunar)
requirements: Lunar Diplomacy and Lunar spellbook active
67 Magic
1 astral, 1 cosmic, 2 air runes per cast
unlocks: NPC Contact spell: telepathic dialogue with a closed set of useful NPCs from anywhere
Remote collection / approval check dialogue with Advisor Ghrim for Managing Miscellania (cannot change coffer investment via the spell)
Remote contact paths used by Construction contract / estate-agent style loops when those NPCs are on the contact list
Slayer master contact and other utility NPC shortcuts without travel

Miscellania management still requires physical visits (or Fort Miscellania table) to change worker distribution and coffer deposits; Contact is collection/status, not full remote kingdom control. After all Livid Farm spells, Pauline can also appear on the contact list for wishes.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Fremennik Lunar dependency. Surface as Construction and kingdom-management QoL, not as a combat unlock.

activity_additions.name: Plank Make (Lunar)
requirements: Dream Mentor completed (Lunar Diplomacy pre-req)
Lunar spellbook active
86 Magic
2 astral, 15 earth, 1 nature runes plus coins per log converted
unlocks: Plank Make: convert one targeted log into the matching plank without a sawmill run
Bankstanding Construction material conversion when logs and coins are available
Pair with Managing Miscellania hardwood/maple supply for self-sufficient plank loops
activity_additions.notes: Dream Mentor is the Fremennik Lunar expansion quest (Lunar Isle / dream sequence). Coin costs scale by log tier (wiki: wood/oak/teak/mahogany). Plank Make does not replace sawmill or Invention plank-maker machines; it is the portable Lunar conversion path. Cross-pressure with Asgarnia house-teleport plank makers and Morytania Razmire remains optional supply, not a second hard region for the spell.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Fremennik via Dream Mentor + Lunar. Log supply often Miscellania (same region) or multi-region Woodcutting.

activity_additions.name: Superglass Make (Lunar)
requirements: Dream Mentor completed
Lunar spellbook active
77 Magic
2 astral, 6 fire, 10 air runes per inventory cast
unlocks: Superglass Make: convert backpack sand + soda ash / seaweed pairs into molten glass without a furnace

activity_additions.name: Lunar Farming utility spells
requirements: Lunar Diplomacy for Cure Plant and Fertile Soil
Livid Farm produce points for Remote Farm (and other Livid spells)
Magic levels: Cure Plant 66, Fertile Soil 83, Remote Farm 78
unlocks: Cure Plant: cure a targeted farming patch of disease
Fertile Soil: treat a targeted patch as supercomposted
Remote Farm (Livid Farm unlock): inspect any farming patch status remotely, cure disease, and cast Fertile Soil through the interface
Remote farm device later reuses Remote Farm without runes once Farming reputation and Livid unlocks allow construction
activity_additions.notes: Bundle the Farming-facing Lunar spells so planners surface Fremennik as a Farming QoL region, not only a Magic unlock. Remote Farm is Livid Farm gated; base Cure Plant / Fertile Soil are not. Remote farm device also needs Farming reputation (global/POF system) — that is not a second Fremennik hard gate.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Fremennik owns Lunar + Livid Farm geography on Lunar Isle. Treat Remote Farm as a second milestone after base Lunar Diplomacy.

activity_additions.name: Livid Farm Lunar spell unlocks
requirements: Lunar Diplomacy completed
Lunar Isle / Livid Farm access
Produce points from Livid Farm cycles (or livid plant redemptions) to buy each spell
unlocks: Eleven additional Lunar spells purchased with produce points (teleports, Repair Rune Pouch, Remote Farm, Borrowed Power, and related Livid rewards)
Post-spell wishes that modify selected Lunar skilling spell behaviour once every spell is learned
NPC Contact entry for Pauline after the full Livid spell set
activity_additions.notes: Livid Farm is the long-tail Lunar completion activity on Lunar Isle. Do not list every teleport cost here; surface that full Lunar skilling utility is not finished at Lunar Diplomacy / Dream Mentor alone. activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Fremennik activity on Lunar Isle. Resolve produce-point costs from current wiki if a planner needs exact purchase order.

activity_additions.name: Managing Miscellania
requirements: Throne of Miscellania completed to start the kingdom
Royal Trouble completed for 15 workers, +50% resources per GP, and 7.5M coffer cap
Coffers funded (500k / 750k minimum for max daily salary before / after Royal Trouble)
Approval rating maintained via Miscellania tasks or Fort Command Centre Miscellania table (tier 3 holds approval)
unlocks: Daily subject labour across mining, maple wood, herbs/flax, fishing (raw or cooked), hardwood teak/mahogany, and farming seeds
Self-sufficient maple/teak/mahogany log supply for Firemaking and Construction
Passive coal, herbs, fish, bird nests, and seed packages for multi-skill sustain
NPC Contact collection path and Fort Forinthry Miscellania table management path
activity_additions.notes: Silent supply backbone called out in ironman gap audits: Construction planks, Firemaking maple/mahogany, Cooking fish, Farming seeds, Summoning dragon food pressure. Resources are calculated from average daily approval and coffer spend, then applied using the subject distribution active at collection time. Hard Fremennik geography (Miscellania / Etceteria). Do not invent daily GE profit tables here.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Fremennik passive supply. Fort Miscellania table is Forinthry cross-QoL for management, not a second hard region for kingdom unlock.

activity_additions.name: Neitiznot yak Crafting and Cooking loop

Started The Fremennik Isles to craft yak-hide armour pieces
unlocks: Yak pen with guaranteed yak-hide, hair, raw yak meat, and bones
Bank chests, spinning wheel, furnace, and local tanner (Thakkrad Sigmundson cures yak-hides for 5 coins)
Yak-hide armour Crafting (cured hides + needle/thread) and hair-to-rope spinning
Dense early Crafting training loop colocated with bank

activity_additions.league_treatment: Fremennik Isles access is Fremennik-region geography. Resolve Fremennik Isles quest auto-completion separately.
